blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY- Government workers seized 30.9 kilos of undocumented meat in Baggao, Cagayan on Tuesday, the Baggao Information Office reported on Wednesday. At a checkpoint in Mocag village, members of the Anti-African Swine Fever Task Force seized the meat, which was stacked in three cardboard boxes that were being transported by a motorcycle on Tuesday.
